statement.p: Find an equation of the tangent plane to the surface z = \frac{25}{4x+3y} at the point (4,3,1).

static.solution: f(x,y,z) = \frac{25}{4x+3y} - z, so the given surface is the level surface of f(x,y,z) = 0. Since \mbox{grad } f = \langle -\frac{100}{\left(4x+3y\right)^{2}}, -\frac{75}{\left(4x+3y\right)^{2}}, -1 \rangle, we have \mbox{grad } f(4,3,1) = \langle -\frac{100}{625}, \frac{75}{625}, -1 \rangle, and the equation of the tangent plane at 4, 3, 1 is -\frac{100}{625} (x - 4) - \frac{75}{625} (y - 3) - (z - 1) = 0, or z = 1 -\frac{100}{625} (x - 4) - \frac{75}{625} (y - 3).
